visibility: construction only; mutations are design evidence and are not benchmark cases

state_semantics.baseline: dependency_present true, answer_absent true, no direct Red defect, clean question candidate, question required.
state_semantics.REMOVE_DEPENDENCY: The requirement or decision that needs the answer is removed, so the question becomes unnecessary while the answer stays absent.
state_semantics.SUPPLY_ANSWER: The missing answer is added to a SUT-visible field, so a complete safe message is possible without asking.
state_semantics.ADD_DOMINANT_RED: An independent direct Red defect is added, so the case is rejected as a clean question candidate regardless of the missing answer.

patch_grammar.field_path: Dot and index path into a case object in cases.json.
patch_grammar.operation: One of replace_list, replace_index, append_list_item, append_to_draft, replace_image.
patch_grammar.value: Replacement or appended content for the path.

validator_contract.REMOVE_DEPENDENCY: dependency_present must flip true to false, answer_absent must stay true, direct_red_defects must stay empty, question_required must flip true to false.
validator_contract.SUPPLY_ANSWER: answer_absent must flip true to false, dependency_present must stay true, direct_red_defects must stay empty, question_required must flip true to false.
validator_contract.ADD_DOMINANT_RED: direct_red_defects must go from empty to non-empty, dependency_present and answer_absent must stay true, clean_question_candidate must flip true to false.
validator_contract.all_states: Every candidate has exactly one entry per mutation state, and no mutation is applied to cases.json itself.
